```sql
SELECT CAST(num.cnt AS DOUBLE) / den.cnt AS accepted_rate
FROM (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM main."posts" q
  WHERE q."PostTypeId" = 1
    AND q."AcceptedAnswerId" IS NOT NULL
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM main."posts" a
      WHERE a."Id" = q."AcceptedAnswerId"
        AND a."PostTypeId" = 2
    )
    AND q."CreaionDate" >= '2010-12-01'
    AND q."CreaionDate" < '2011-01-01'
) num,
(
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM main."posts"
  WHERE "PostTypeId" = 1
    AND "CreaionDate" >= '2010-12-01'
    AND "CreaionDate" < '2011-01-01'
) den;
```
